name: Cloudflare
subtitle: Edge serverless compute (Workers and Pages)
creator: Cloudflare (founded 2009); Workers launched 2017

version.label: Hosted platform (runtime workerd is open source)

description: Workers run JavaScript, TypeScript and WebAssembly in lightweight isolates across Cloudflare's global network. Static front ends are served alongside, and bindings connect code to KV, D1 (SQLite), R2 object storage, Durable Objects and Queues.

languages.youWrite: JavaScript or TypeScript, plus Python and Rust via WASM; config in wrangler.jsonc

concepts.explanation: Lightweight sandboxes that start almost instantly.
Your Worker receives a Request and returns a Response.
Connect to KV, D1, R2 and Durable Objects.
Billing and limits are based on CPU time.

codeSamples.label: JavaScript · a Worker

pricing.summary: Free: 100,000 Worker requests per day. Workers Paid: $5/mo including 10M requests and 30M CPU-ms, then $0.30 per million requests. Static asset requests are free.

surveys.source: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, all respondents
